subject.title: feat: add publisher follow graph API

question: Should ClawHub accept this publisher-follow API-token surface as the base follow-graph boundary now, or pause it until the stacked controls and notification PRs are reviewed together?
rationale: The implementation is a new core API and private user-state boundary, so ClawSweeper can identify proof/docs gaps but cannot decide the product boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Gate the API slice on proof and contracts
options.body: Require redacted runtime proof plus OpenAPI/docs and sourcemap updates, then review this base API as the first follow-graph slice.

options.title: Review the full stack together
options.body: Pause this base PR until the dependent controls/discovery and notification PRs are ready enough to validate the end-to-end product boundary.

options.title: Accept the boundary without live proof
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept CI-only evidence, but that owns the private follow-state auth boundary without contributor runtime proof.

recommendation.title: Gate the API slice on proof and contracts
recommendation.body: Require redacted runtime proof plus OpenAPI/docs and sourcemap updates, then review this base API as the first follow-graph slice.

likelyOwner.reason: The touched public route/schema package contract is most directly tied to Patrick-Erichsen's recent merged history.
